dispute_letter.subject: Request to review water account for September 2026
dispute_letter.text:
To: Accounts Department, Karoo Bay Metro
Date: 2026-11-04

Account number: 1004 7781 02
Account holder: T. Demo
Service address: 7 Placeholder Lane, Karoo Bay
Invoice number: KBM-762511
Billing period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30

Subject: Request to review water account for September 2026

Dear Accounts Department,

I have checked my water bill for September 2026 against the published tariff and found the points set out below. I would be grateful for your help in looking into them.

1. The total billed for this period is R875.15, while the published tariff works out to R740.60 for the 18.0 kl charged. In the 'Water 6-15 kl' block, the account was charged at R38.00/kl instead of the tariff rate of R25.00/kl, which comes to R342.00 billed versus R225.00. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2, rcpt-3, rcpt-4)

2. The two most recent meter readings, on 31 August 2026 and 30 September 2026, were both estimated rather than actual. This means the charge for this period is not based on an actual reading. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2)

3. The billed use for this period is 18.0 kl, which is close to the normal average of 18.0 kl from previous bills. However, according to the outage log, 9 of the 30 days in this period had no supply, and normal daily use over the 21 supplied days would imply about 12.6 kl. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2, rcpt-3, rcpt-4)

I would be grateful if you could review the points listed above and correct the account where you agree with them. A written response would be much appreciated.

Kind regards,
T. Demo
